name: onboarding_started
description: A person entered an onboarding flow. The funnel entry and the denominator for every adoption rate derived from onboarding.
trigger: The first step of the flow is presented to the person, whether or not they interact with it. Once per person per flow.
nonTriggers: Do not fire on sign-up or account creation — those are separate lifecycle events.
Do not fire again when the person resumes a flow they already started; resumption is not a new entry.
Do not fire when the flow is rendered but hidden, prefetched, or shown to an automated session.

properties.name: flow_id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the onboarding flow, e.g. initial_setup. A flow, not a flow run.
